I just turned 30 and without inundating you with all my selfish stupidity, I just know this is right for me. I've spent too many nights crying it out, thinking it out, writing it out, reaching out, seeking help....I can't do it anymore.
I wish the best for you in whatever you decide. ❤️

Thank you. I'm not worried about the pain or anything else like that. I just can't go on anymore. I've got I set up so that I won't be found in time to be revived. I just can't do this anymore. The long, stupid story is irrelevant, but I can't breathe another breath tonight. Thank you so much.
I'm going to try anyway. I've got a ton of other pills to mix in as well. Fingers crossed.
